description: Search Spanish public procurement notices (PLACSP) by object/buyer text, CPV prefix, phase, province, buyer NIF, supplier CIF, open status, amount range (requires amount_kind) and publication dates. Cursor-paginated: pass back `cursor` for the next page. Constraints: free text cannot be combined with structured filters, and `cpv` combines only with the date filters (otherwise the API answers 422). Supplier names are not searchable; use supplier_cif.

amount_kind.description: Which monetary concept min_amount_eur/max_amount_eur refer to. Required with either bound.

buyer_nif.description: NIF of the contracting body (corporate identifiers only).

cpv.description: CPV code prefix, 2-8 digits (e.g. "72" for IT services). Combines only with the date filters.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response to get the next page. Invalid if any filter changes.

open_only.description: Only notices still open for bids.

phase.description: Notice phase: PUB published, PRE prior notice, EV evaluation, ADJ awarded, RES resolved, ANUL annulled.

province.description: Province slug, e.g. "madrid". Rows not yet geocoded are excluded.

q.description: Terms in the notice object or buyer name (supplier names are NOT searched).

supplier_cif.description: CIF of the awarded supplier (corporate identifiers only).

name: borme_search_tenders
